Ye islands of the northern sea
Ye islands of the northern sea,
His word like fire, prepares his way,
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 97:1, 3, 5–7, 11, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad. 3Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side. 5The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth. 6The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory. 7All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods! 11Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart. PSALM 97:1, 3, 5–7, 11 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 97
Ye islands of the northern sea, Rejoice, the Saviour reigns; His word like fire, prepares his way, And mountains melt to plains. STANZA I
